research.title: Occlusion Sensitivity in Object Detection
bullets: Designed controlled experiments varying occlusion placement and object visibility to compare existing object detectors under matched evaluation conditions.
Analyzed localization errors and missed detections by object size, separating effects of foreground obstruction from background clutter.

research.title: Confidence Calibration Under Image Corruptions
bullets: Designed experiments comparing temperature scaling and uncalibrated predictions across image classifiers exposed to blur, noise, and contrast changes.
Analyzed reliability diagrams and classwise errors to distinguish confidence miscalibration from changes in classification accuracy across corruption types.

research.title: Appearance Shift and Boundary Errors in Semantic Segmentation
bullets: Designed experiments evaluating existing semantic segmentation models across lighting and texture shifts, with controlled augmentation and training data comparisons.
Analyzed classwise overlap and boundary errors, examining whether aggregate segmentation metrics concealed failures on thin structures and visually ambiguous regions.

publications.title: Evaluating Appearance Augmentation for Semantic Segmentation Under Lighting and Texture Shifts
Beyond Region Overlap: Boundary Errors in Semantic Segmentation Under Appearance Shift

work.title: Image Processing Service Maintenance
bullets: Implemented image validation and preprocessing components for an existing upload service, handling unsupported formats, malformed inputs, and inconsistent image dimensions.
Maintained regression tests and investigated processing failures using service logs, documenting reproducible cases and verifying fixes against previously failing inputs.

projects.title: Local Feature Matching for Image Alignment
bullets: Implemented image alignment using local feature descriptors and robust homography estimation, following established pipelines for matching overlapping photographs.
Compared descriptor choices and matching thresholds using reprojection error and visual inspection across changes in viewpoint, illumination, and scene texture.

projects.title: Transfer Learning for Fine-Grained Image Classification
bullets: Implemented frozen feature extraction and partial fine-tuning of pretrained convolutional networks for fine-grained classification using a shared training pipeline.
Compared validation performance and confusion patterns under matched data splits, examining sensitivity to augmentation choices and class imbalance.

projects.title: Classical and Convolutional Image Denoising
bullets: Implemented bilateral filtering and a convolutional denoising baseline, generating paired noisy and clean images through controlled synthetic noise injection.
Compared reconstruction metrics and inspected edge preservation across noise conditions, documenting differences between smoothing artifacts and residual noise.

projects.title: Dense Motion Estimation in Image Sequences
bullets: Implemented coarse-to-fine Lucas–Kanade and Horn–Schunck optical flow baselines, using shared image preprocessing and consistent motion visualization procedures.
Compared endpoint errors and qualitative flow fields, examining failures around motion boundaries, textureless regions, and displacements exceeding local estimation assumptions.
